cards.stem: What measure did delegates adopt to protect liberty and lives during meetings?
cards.quote: The delegates to Congress adopted strict rules of secrecy to protect the cause of American liberty and their own lives.
cards.hint: Think about why meetings were kept private.

cards.stem: Which element was included among the three parts of the Lee proposal?
options: a call to form foreign alliances
a permanent tax agreement with Parliament
a joint military parade in London
cards.quote: The Lee Resolution contained three parts: a declaration of independence, a call to form foreign alliances, and "a plan for confederation."
cards.hint: Recall the three distinct aims listed together.

cards.stem: What did Congress create on June 11, 1776 to handle the resolution?
cards.quote: On June 11, 1776, the Congress appointed three concurrent committees in response to the Lee Resolution: one to draft a declaration of independence,
cards.hint: Remember how tasks were divided that day.
